mapper.select: SELECT id, payment_no, order_no, user_id, channel, amount, status, third_trade_no, callback_content, pay_time, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM payment_record WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, payment_no, order_no, user_id, channel, amount, status FROM payment_record WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 0 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_record (id, payment_no, order_no, user_id, channel, amount, status, third_trade_no, pay_time, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{paymentNo}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{channel}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{thirdTradeNo}, #{payTime}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_record SET status = 1, third_trade_no = #{thirdTradeNo}, pay_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} AND status = 0 AND deleted = 0
